checks.description: Security context controls the allocation of security parameters for the pod/container/volume, ensuring the appropriate level of protection. Relying on default security context may expose vulnerabilities to potential attacks that rely on privileged access.
messages: pod privileged in kubyl-trivy namespace is using the default security context, which allows root privileges
checks.remediation: To enhance security, it is strongly recommended not to rely on the default security context. Instead, it is advisable to explicitly define the required security parameters (such as runAsNonRoot, capabilities, readOnlyRootFilesystem, etc.) within the security context.
checks.title: Default security context configured

checks.description: An immutable root file system prevents applications from writing to their local disk. This can limit intrusions, as attackers will not be able to tamper with the file system or write foreign executables to disk.
messages: Container 'shell' of Pod 'privileged' should set 'securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem' to true
checks.title: Root file system is not read-only

checks.description: A program inside the container can bypass Seccomp protection policies.
messages: container "shell" of pod "privileged" in "kubyl-trivy" namespace should specify a seccomp profile
checks.remediation: Specify seccomp either by annotation or by seccomp profile type having allowed values as per pod security standards
checks.title: Seccomp policies disabled

checks.description: Enforcing CPU limits prevents DoS via resource exhaustion.
checks.title: CPU not limited

checks.description: Sharing the host’s network namespace permits processes in the pod to communicate with processes bound to the host’s loopback adapter.
messages: Pod 'privileged' should not set 'spec.template.spec.hostNetwork' to true
checks.title: Access to host network

checks.description: When containers have memory requests specified, the scheduler can make better decisions about which nodes to place pods on, and how to deal with resource contention.
checks.title: Memory requests not specified

checks.description: ensure that Pod specifications disable the secret token being mounted by setting automountServiceAccountToken: false
messages: Container of Pod 'privileged' should set 'spec.automountServiceAccountToken' to false
checks.remediation: Disable the mounting of service account secret token by setting automountServiceAccountToken to false
checks.title: Protecting Pod service account tokens

checks.description: Force the container to run with user ID > 10000 to avoid conflicts with the host’s user table.
checks.title: Runs with UID <= 10000

checks.description: According to pod security standard 'Seccomp', the RuntimeDefault seccomp profile must be required, or allow specific additional profiles.
messages: Either Pod or Container should set 'securityContext.seccompProfile.type' to 'RuntimeDefault'
checks.title: Runtime/Default Seccomp profile not set

checks.description: A program inside the container can elevate its own privileges and run as root, which might give the program control over the container and node.
messages: Container 'shell' of Pod 'privileged' should set 'securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation' to false
checks.title: Can elevate its own privileges

checks.description: Privileged containers share namespaces with the host system and do not offer any security. They should be used exclusively for system containers that require high privileges.
messages: Container 'shell' of Pod 'privileged' should set 'securityContext.privileged' to false
checks.title: Privileged

checks.description: Enforcing memory limits prevents DoS via resource exhaustion.
checks.title: Memory not limited

checks.description: Force the container to run with group ID > 10000 to avoid conflicts with the host’s user table.
checks.title: Runs with GID <= 10000

checks.description: Containers should be forbidden from running with a root UID.
messages: securityContext.runAsUser should be set to a value greater than 0
checks.remediation: Set 'securityContext.runAsUser' to a non-zero integer or leave undefined.
checks.title: Containers must not set runAsUser to 0

checks.description: When containers have resource requests specified, the scheduler can make better decisions about which nodes to place pods on, and how to deal with resource contention.
checks.title: CPU requests not specified

checks.description: Containers must drop ALL capabilities, and are only permitted to add back the NET_BIND_SERVICE capability.
checks.remediation: Set 'spec.containers[*].securityContext.capabilities.drop' to 'ALL' and only add 'NET_BIND_SERVICE' to 'spec.containers[*].securityContext.capabilities.add'.
checks.title: Container capabilities must only include NET_BIND_SERVICE

checks.description: The container should drop all default capabilities and add only those that are needed for its execution.
messages: Container 'shell' of Pod 'privileged' should add 'ALL' to 'securityContext.capabilities.drop'
checks.title: Default capabilities: some containers do not drop all

checks.description: Force the running image to run as a non-root user to ensure least privileges.
messages: Container 'shell' of Pod 'privileged' should set 'securityContext.runAsNonRoot' to true
checks.title: Runs as root user

checks.description: Security best practices require containers to run with minimal required capabilities.
messages: Container 'shell' of 'pod' 'privileged' in 'kubyl-trivy' namespace should set securityContext.capabilities.drop
checks.remediation: Specify at least one unneeded capability in 'containers[].securityContext.capabilities.drop'
checks.title: Default capabilities: some containers do not drop any
